title: Output of a prompt under tuning
when_to_use: The answer a model gave to a prompt you are tuning, judged for the person who asked.
facts_hint: paste the prompt the output answers and the facts it may use

personas.description: Person who sent the prompt and needs the answer to do a task now; reads it once and acts on it.

dimensions.name: Does the task
dimensions.question: Does the output do what the prompt asked, all of it?

anchors.1: the output does a different task
anchors.3: the output does part of the task, or adds what was not asked
anchors.5: the output does every part of the task and nothing else

dimensions.name: Accuracy
dimensions.question: Is every factual claim consistent with the facts section?

anchors.3: claims are consistent, some are unsupported
anchors.5: every claim is consistent with the facts, and unsupported points are marked as such

dimensions.name: Format
dimensions.question: Does the output follow the format the prompt asked for?

anchors.1: the output uses another format than the one asked; the judge names which
anchors.3: the asked format with one deviation the judge names
anchors.5: the asked format with no deviation
